p:cNvPr.descr: Structures of various isoprenoid compounds or derivatives. (d) Ubiquinone, a mitochondrial electron carrier (coenzyme Q) (n= 4 to 8) (labeled left). Its left ring has 2 vertical double bonds. The top and bottom C are double bonded up and down to O. From the top, C double bonds up to O and left to C, which bonds left to CHO3 and double bonds down to C, which bonds left to CHO3 and down and right to C, which double bonds down to O and up & right to C, which bonds right to CH2 and double bonds up to C, which bonds up & right to CH3 and up & left to C. A pink dashed line bisects the bond between the ring and CH2. CH2 bonds right to CH, which double bonds right to C, which bonds up to CH3 and right to CH2. To the right of this CH2 there is a dashed pink line bisecting the bond. To the right of the pink line is a portion of the chain in parentheses: CH2 bonds right to CH, which double bonds right to C and up to CH3. C bonds right to CH2. To the right is the closing parenthese with n on the outside, representing 4 to 8. The rest of the chain, to the right, consists of CH2 bonding right to CH, which double bonds right to C, which bonds up to CH3 and right to CH3. Below is (e) plastoquinone, a chloroplast electron carrier (n = 4 to 8) (labeled left). Its left ring has 2 vertical double bonds. The top and bottom C are double bonded up & down to O. From the top, C double bonds up to O and left to C, which bonds left to CH3 and double bonds down to C, which bonds left to CH3 and down and right to C, which double bonds down to O and up and right to C, which bonds right to CH2 and double bonds up to C, which bonds up and right to CH3, and up and left to C. A pink dashed line bisects the bond between the ring and CH2. CH2 bonds right to CH, which double bonds right to C, which bonds up to CH3 and right to CH2. To the right of this CH2, there is a dashed pink line bisecting the bond. To the right of the pink line is a portion of the chain in parentheses: CH2 bonds right to CH, which double bonds right to C and up to CH3. C bonds right to CH2. To the right is the closing parentheses with n on the outside, representing 4 to 8. The rest of the chain, to the right, consists of CH2 bonding right to CH, which double bonds right to C, which bonds up to CH3 and right to CH3. Below is (f) dolichol, a sugar carrier (n = 9 to 22) (labeled left). It consists of an OH bonded right to CH2. There is a dashed pink line bisecting this bond. CH2 bonds right to CH2, which bonds right to CH. CH bonds up to CH3 and right to CH2. To the right, there is another dashed pink line. To the right of the line re parentheses containing CH2 bonded right to CH, which double bonds right to C. C bonds up to CH3 and right to CH2. Here there are parentheses with the letter n outside it, representing any number from 9 to 22. To the right of this is another dashed pink line. To the right of the line is CH2 bonded right to CH, which double bonds to C, which bonds up to CH3 and right to CH3.
